requirements.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1.
requirements.summary: The executor created a local repository containing the signed tree RPM and generated metadata, configured and started Apache, and successfully retrieved both metadata and the RPM over node1's HTTP endpoint. After reboot, Apache was active and enabled, port 80 was listening, HTTP requests returned 200, and the local repository remained queryable.

requirements.requirement: Install a package from the local repository while the usual remote repositories are unreachable.
requirements.summary: During a bounded outage test, cdn.redhat.com resolved to an unreachable address, a direct reachability check failed as expected, and BaseOS and AppStream metadata requests timed out. DNF then installed tree from local-offline; RPM state, execution, and recorded repository provenance were verified. The temporary hosts override was removed, including across the subsequent reboot.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied with direct behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: node1 had a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged a scheduled reboot, became temporarily unavailable, returned with a different boot ID, and recovered the HTTP service, repository contents, installed package, provenance, and execution. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the identity change.
limitations: Captured command output was bounded in places, but the truncated portions are not material to the scored outcomes.
Minor executor-created files remained in /tmp after completion.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified in the chronological command trace: prerequisite package installation, repository and HTTP configuration, bounded remote-outage simulation, cache clearing, package installation, and reboot all had clear task or verification roles. The temporary /etc/hosts override was fully reverted. Hygiene was slightly reduced because three executor-created evidence artifacts remained in /tmp: repomd.pre, repomd.post, and benchmark-reboot.log. No failed services or package-health damage was observed after execution. The new port 80 listener is required by the task.
